_doc: Default device tiers. A project overrides this with <perf dir>/devices.json (same shape). A phone joins a tier by its model string (the DEVICE line of the run log, adb shell getprop ro.product.model). A tier without a measured phone shows 'not measured' in the report; never estimate it.

tiers.label: Low-end
tiers.hint: entry GPUs (Adreno 6xx low, Mali-G5x), about 3-4 GB RAM
